item.description: Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS) The Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS) (台美人歷史協會) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to documenting, preserving, and promoting Taiwanese American history, culture, and heritage.
